content: Cabaiguán is a premium cigar brand that is entirely hand-made and owned by Tatuaje Cigars, Inc. The brand was developed by Pete Johnson in collaboration with Jaime Garcia, who is the son of José Pepin Garcia. These cigars are produced at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in Little Havana, Miami, Florida. The Cabaiguán cigars feature a filler blend composed of Nicaraguan tobaccos. The binder is also Nicaraguan, while the wrapper is a Connecticut Seed shade-grown leaf cultivated in Ecuador. This combination of tobaccos results in a medium-bodied cigar. The brand was first introduced to the market in 2004 and is available in four different sizes, known as vitolas. For additional information and photographs, you can visit Vitolas.net. Further details about the brand can also be found in the 2006 edition of Perelman's Pocket Cyclopedia of Cigars by Richard B. Perelman, published by Perelman, Pioneer & Co. in Los Angeles.
